name: Death Knight Blackguard

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Plate Armor
items.description:
The heaviest type of armor, made up of shaped plates of metal or similarly resilient material, plate provides the most armor protection. The cost for its superior fortification is mobility and agility.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Plate armor grants +9 AC at levels 6-10, +10 AC at levels 11-15, +11 AC at levels 16-20, +12 AC at levels 21-25, and +14 AC at levels 26-30.

items.name: Light Shield
items.description: While you’re using a light shield, you can use your shield hand to hold another item, to climb, and the like, but you can’t make attacks with that hand or with anything in it.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Slayer of the Living
traits.details: Whenever an enemy ends its turn in the aura, the death knight slides that enemy up to 3 squares.

auras.name: Slayer of the Living
auras.details: Whenever an enemy ends its turn in the aura, the death knight slides that enemy up to 3 squares.

effect.description: The death knight shifts up to 2 squares.

powers.name: Double Strike
powers.requirements: The death knight must be wielding a soulsword.

effect.description: The death knight uses soulsword twice, making each attack against a different enemy.

powers.name: Overpowering Attack
powers.requirements: The death knight must be wielding a soulsword.

hit.description: necrotic damage, and the death knight slides the target up to 2 squares.

effect.description: Close burst 5 (one enemy in the burst). The target grants combat advantage until the end of the death knight’s next turn.

powers.name: Implacable
powers.trigger: The death knight becomes marked, slowed, immobilized, dazed, or stunned by an effect.

effect.description: The death knight makes a saving throw to end the triggering effect, even if the effect would not normally end on a save.
